note: The 8 height transects of the 2026-09-27 flatness survey (survey_flatness.md section 3). transects.csv holds each one at 2 m stations: s (m along), x, z (game frame), truth_m = the median of 5 samples across +-3 m of the centreline on the USGS 3DEP 1 m bare-earth DEM (public domain), and mask: 0 measured, 1 on or beside a bridge (lidar removes decks), 2 wall/spike or a grade-separated crossing within 30 m (or a >7% jump on the freeway), 3 no data. roadside.csv: every 5th station, the unit normal the offsets were taken along and the 3DEP land height at -60, -30, +30, +60 m. core10.ptru.gz: 3DEP at 10 m (2x2 mean of the survey's 5 m grid) over the 8 x 8 km core. city120.ptru.gz: 3DEP 30 m area-averaged to the game DEM's 60 m nodes, every 2nd node (120 m). Source: USGS 3DEP ImageServer exportImage (F32 GeoTIFF, bilinear), georeferenced from the returned tags (the service grows the requested box); check: Trade & Tryon 232.59 m against EPQS 232.59 m. Frozen from the survey's cache by WP-01 so every later package measures against the same reference offline.
grade_note: grade = CityElevation.MaxGrade for the transect's class, used by the metrics' emulation of solver step 1 (sigma 2.5 stations + grade clamp).
